scope: Original Toolkit wireless Status dialog and Reset/Recall operational-statistics command wrappers. MAISync is a separate native C-Gate action, not an identified original Status callback.
evidence_kind: Static original x86 source recovery only; method bytes independently rehashed from the pinned executable. No original component execution, C-Gate DO execution, physical query, network opening or radio operation.

profile_boundary.original_gui_class: TfrmWirelessUnit.SetData0x10d23e8 and TcdWirelessUnitStatus.SetData0x10d1498 assert IsClass(TCBusWirelessUnit), class metadata0xaf4400. The shared CreateStatusForm0x10d2fd8 creates TcdWirelessUnitStatus without an advanced-gateway check.
profile_boundary.firmware: No firmware comparison appears in these shared Status admission paths. The WGATE5F2.2.90..2.4.99 edit-workflow bound must not be treated as the native action catalogue bound.
profile_boundary.executor: Exact native class/catalogue admission and DO/GET response shapes require the separate pinned C-Gate action source review. This receipt does not infer eligible concrete unit types from an arbitrary wireless name prefix.
profile_boundary.initialization: SetData asserts TCBusWirelessUnit and stores pointer only; no firmware check or refresh. Create initializes online,busy,callbackbusy,refreshfailed=false. Initialise creates frame, hides Update/Reset/grids, binds clicks, no initial I/O. External framework RefreshData (VMT+0x14) sets refresh-eligibility=IsPhysicalUnit OR HasMatchingPhysicalUnit, then calls RefreshDataOnForm. HasMatchingPhysicalUnit is recomputed as online. Retry Update visible when refreshfailed and eligible; successful online PopulateGUI reveals both buttons/grids.

status_parameters.excluded_from_original_grid: UnitTemperature is a native property but is not one of the three original Status grid parameters.
status_parameters.display: Only UnitSupplyVoltage receives a textual first case-sensitive mv to space+mV substitution. There is no numeric rescaling in FormatParameterValue.

display_rows.name: UnitSupplyVoltage
display_rows.label: Processor Supply Voltage
display_rows.format: Replace first case-sensitive mv with space+mV; StringReplace flags0

original_refresh.entry: btnUpdateStatusClick0x10d1c08 invokes RefreshDataOnForm0x10d17cc after the active-context/busy guards and disables Update/Reset during the call. RefreshDataOnForm also has its own reentry guard and restores cursor/guard in finally.
order: RefreshDataOnForm: determine HasMatchingPhysicalUnit; acquire busy guard
Update grid only after successful recall and GET
original_refresh.resync: Resync0x10d19d4 uses ParameterSync and TimeOut=15000. Unit AgentLoad0xcb6228..6293 recognizes ParameterSync, obtains timeout, and calls CommandDoPSync0xcc08c8; TcgcDoPsync.GenerateCommandText0xcb3098 emits do <target> Psync. It is not MAISync.
original_refresh.target: CommandDoPSync uses project-prefix plus OID for an existing object, otherwise GetPhysicalAddress. Reset/Recall helpers use GetAddressAsCGateID. An adapter that admits only a canonical physical address is a deliberate narrower target boundary.
original_refresh.failure: Resync begins timeoutflag=false. Success sets refreshfailed=false. ECGateCommandTimeOut -> online=false,refreshfailed=true,timeoutflag=true. ECGateErrorPSyncUnitNotFound -> online=false,refreshfailed=true. No automatic retry in director. PopulateGUI skips both parameter/stat loads when online=false. Timeout text Failed to load status parameters from unit; missing/offline text Unit not found at this address on network. Reset/recall/get false shows Cannot access wireless unit. Parameter GET false only omits that row. Old stats grid is preserved on recall/GET false because Clear occurs only after both successes.
original_refresh.cache: C-Gate GET properties are cached reads according to the separate native source review. A cached-only adapter operation must not imply original refresh or current physical measurements.
original_refresh.broader_psync_boundary: Native source follow-up traces Psync through wireless diagnostics and status refresh, including application/error/serial cache changes. Psync is broader than reading cached measurements; its physical path is not executed or accepted by this receipt.

original_reset.entry: btnResetOpStatsClick asks confirmation0xC0F first; on return1, enabled owner and not callback-busy, disables Update and Reset, calls ResetOperationalStatistics, restores buttons in finally. ResetOperationalStatistics uses shared busy guard; ResetOpStats true -> Resync -> PopulateGUI (thus same ordered parameter/recall/stats refresh). False -> error0xC10, no refresh. Catches only ECGateErrorResetOpStatsUnitNotFound -> error0xC07; other exceptions unwind through busy cleanup.
success_order: PopulateGUI: three parameter GETs, RecallOpStats, then GET OpStats
original_reset.failure: When ResetOpStats returns false, no subsequent refresh is performed. One typed reset-only adapter action must not claim to reproduce the complete GUI callback sequence or infer counters are zero from send completion.

command_wrappers.completion: Reset/Recall OnProcessResults recognizes 202 plus Done and calls SetCompleted. Both map 401/Bad object/Unit not found or Operation failed to a unit-not-found exception, 420/Access denied/Insufficient access level to insufficient-access exception, and 408 to a generic No Catalog Available error. Recall additionally marks completed in its408 branch; that is still failure, never success.
command_wrappers.retry: Reset/Recall wrappers each call CommandExecute once and contain no retry loop. Reviewed CommandExecute0x843860 calls InternalSendCommand0x8437bc once for the operation; an optional distinct prefix command is not an operation retry. InternalSendCommand calls SendCommand once when connected, otherwise records Not connected to C-Gate. Lower native bus retry behavior belongs to the C-Gate review.
command_wrappers.stats_parsing: ParseResults0x10d04fc extracts text after OpStats={ through the closing brace, replaces semicolons with commas, loads a TStringList, and ExpandNames0x10d0644 rewrites counter names for display. Preserve the exact native counter-key contract in the typed parser instead of treating display labels as wire keys.

absence_checks.automatic_timer: The original TFRMWIRELESSUNITSTATUS form resource has no Timer/OnTimer token and the reviewed Status director methods expose no timer callback. This is a manual/event-driven Status dialog, not evidence for periodic polling.
absence_checks.mai_sync: No MAISync/maisync/MAISYNC literal was found in pinned EXE ASCII or UTF-16, and no reviewed Status callback invokes it. Native MAISync implementation does not establish an original Toolkit GUI action.

bounded_adapter_contract: Separate cached reads from explicit physical requests in API and result metadata.
Report native command success separately from physical hardware acceptance; Reset send completion is not a counter readback.
Do not include ParameterSync in cached-status or silently append it to a bounded action.
A standalone reset or recall operation does not include the original GUI refresh sequence unless that complete sequence is implemented explicitly.
Use fail-closed parsing for failed/malformed native replies; preserve unknown cached status and missing or stale counter data as such.
Do not add automatic retries, PP loads/saves, ProjectSave, network opening or radio pairing to this action boundary.

acceptance.native_action_software_review: Separate C-Gate receipt; cached GET acceptance does not prove a physical refresh.

reproduction: Read-only recover.py symbol extraction against pinned local EXE/MAP with Capstone5.0.7 and pefile2024.8.26; only method metadata/hashes and semantic summaries retained. No proprietary source, binary resource or assembly listing is included.
